subject: URGENT: Aurora Cloud - elevated latency & 5xx in aurora-az2 (routing containment request)
messages:
From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@auroracloud.com>
To: aditya.rao@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-08-25T02:13:00Z
Subject: Spike: 5xx + latency in aurora-az2

Aditya —

We are seeing a sustained increase in 5xx rates (from ~0.2% to 6.8%) and tail latency for token generation across multiple endpoints backing Aurora tenant traffic in aurora-az2 starting ~01:45 UTC. Application-level retries are compounding throughput pressure and causing queueing in our sidecars.

We've opened a PagerDuty incident PDT-54321 and attached a condensed p95/p99 latency chart and request logs (attached: aurora-latency-aug25-az2-logs.zip). Our on-call is asking for any routing or regional steering assistance Redwood can provide immediately while we investigate root cause.

Questions:
- Can Redwood temporarily steer Aurora production traffic away from aurora-az2 to a healthy region (us-west2) for the next 90 mins?
- Any quick mitigations (model variant downgrade, connection backpressure tweaks) you recommend?

We need a customer-facing timeline; our execs are asking for a 30-min update.

Thanks,
Lena Ortiz
Head of SRE, Aurora Cloud

Attachments: aurora-latency-aug25-az2-logs.zip
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@auroracloud.com>
Cc: rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai, hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai, vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-08-25T02:18:00Z
Subject: Re: Spike: 5xx + latency in aurora-az2

Lena — thanks for the alert and the logs. We're on it.

Immediate plan (first 15 min):
- Rishi (Support): can you validate whether this is a capacity saturation issue vs SDK-side retry amplification?
- Hannah (Ops): prep a customer update and schedule a 30-min exec sync (per Lena's ask).
- I'll propose a temporary routing containment to steer ~80% of Aurora prod traffic to us-west2 for 60–90 minutes while we stabilize.

Please confirm whether Aurora is comfortable with temporary regional steering; if yes we'll execute and send a targeted customer update. Attaching our quick checklist and runbook link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-runbook-aurora-az2

Aditya Rao

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: aditya.rao@redwood.ai, hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-08-25T02:25:00Z
Subject: Re: Spike: 5xx + latency in aurora-az2 — initial triage

Quick triage notes:
- Observed patterns in the logs: sustained GPU queue build-up on nodes serving aurora-az2; KV cache hit rates dropped ~18% at the same time of the spike.
- Error class: mix of OOM-adjacent retries and model backpressure (internal 5xx from inference runtime under high concurrency).
- Likely contributors: sudden request fan-in (client retries), and a hot-shard of traffic for a high-cost model variant.

Short mitigations we can do now (will need infra coordination):
1) Immediate model variant downgrade for Aurora's heaviest route (xxl->l or int8 variant) — 5–8% quality tradeoff vs 3–5x throughput improvement.
2) Apply per-tenant rate cap and token-budgeting to limit retry amplification at the gateway (soft throttle).
3) Execute region steering: create routing policy to reweight Aurora routes: aurora-az2 20% / us-west2 80% (gradual 5–10% step every 30s).

I'll start the variant downgrade in canary (20% of traffic) and monitor p95/p99. Need ops to run the routing reweight; Hannah, can you take point?

— Rishi
Sr. Support Engineer, Redwood Inference

I have a 30-min slot with Aurora's leadership starting 02:45 UTC. Suggested brief for execs:
- What happened: sudden queueing + model hot-shard caused internal 5xx and tail latency spikes in aurora-az2.
- Immediate customer impact: elevated p95/p99, elevated error counts for 9% of Aurora's production requests.
- Actions we are taking: steering (80% to us-west2), model variant downgrade canary, gateway soft-throttles.
- Ask for Aurora: approve regional steering & confirm tolerable quality tradeoff for downgraded variant.

I'll draft the external update. Rishi — confirm when the canary shows CPU/GPU queue reduction and improved p99.

Hannah Schmitt

We approve the temporary steering to us-west2 and the model downgrade canary. Please proceed with the 80% reweight and let us know the expected customer-facing message. Aurora execs expect a 15-minute update once traffic is shifted.

Also: we have procurement constraints and cannot accept any data residency moves; we're only asking for routing by region within our existing contract (same region family).

Thanks — Lena

Team — thanks for the rapid coordination. Summary and action items:

1) Executed routing reweight: aurora-az2 -> 20% / us-west2 -> 80% (rolling 10% steps completed by 03:12 UTC).
2) Model variant downgrade: canary at 20% started 02:40 UTC; initial metrics show p95 down 35% on canary shards. Rishi to confirm stability for full roll at 03:25 UTC.
3) Gateway soft-throttle: token budgeting applied to reduce retry amplification.
4) Customer comms: Hannah sent the 15-min update to Aurora execs at 03:15 UTC; Lena confirmed acceptance.

Outstanding: post-mortem ownership (Rishi to lead), follow-up incident report due EOD, and an ask to Pricing/Contracts for temporary credit consideration if SLA breach is observed.

I'll draft the exec summary for our leadership and include the runbook steps taken.

Aditya Rao
